commands.command: set -euo pipefail; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = 757817702d97b6c840736b6117cd15e038580558; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; echo COREDUMP_DIAG_IDENTITY_PASS

source scripts/source_idf.sh >/dev/null; python3 -c "from pathlib import Path; root=Path(__import__('os').environ['IDF_PATH'])/'components'/'espcoredump'; matches=[]; [matches.append((str(p),i,l.strip())) for p in root.rglob('Kconfig*') for i,l in enumerate(p.read_text(errors='ignore').splitlines(),1) if 'COREDUMP' in l or 'core dump' in l.lower()]; print('\n'.join(f'{p}:{i}:{l}' for p,i,l in matches[:120])); print('LOCAL_SDKCONFIG'); sp=Path('sdkconfig'); print('\n'.join(l for l in sp.read_text(errors='ignore').splitlines() if 'COREDUMP' in l) if sp.exists() else 'sdkconfig_missing')"
